title: Human Plasma Metabolite Annotation Resolution
text: MetaboResolveR resolves post-identification untargeted human plasma metabolomics tables plasma-aware annotation outputs. built LC-MS annotation review workflows input table already contains candidate metabolite names database IDs.

title: Human Plasma Metabolite Annotation Resolution
code: library(MetaboResolveR)  input <- data.frame(   Name = c("Glucose", "Caffeine", "Unknown feature"),   HMDB_ID = c("HMDB0000122", "HMDB0001847", "-"),   PubChemID = c("5793", "2519", "-"),   Score = c(0.95, 0.88, 0.50),   check.names = FALSE )  annotated <- annotate_plasma_metabolites(input) annotated[, c("metabolite_name", "matched_reference_key", "final_annotation_class")]

title: Human Plasma Metabolite Annotation Resolution
text: Canonical column handling names, HMDB/HMID, PubChem CID, ChEBI, KEGG, LipidMaps, m/z, retention time, polarity, MS2 score. Human plasma evidence scoring bundled reference sources. title: MetaboResolveR 0.0.0.9000
text: Added local-real-case split validation scripts official .xlsx workbook. Split real workbook ten local chunks annotated 1,416 observed rows without chunk errors. Added automatic aliases vendor-style columns including Name, HMDB_ID, KEGG_ID, Lipidmaps_ID, PubChemID, RT (min), IonMode, Score. Treated placeholder identifiers - N/missing values. Added schema, fixture, local chunk smoke tests. Added public synthetic real-case fixture plus vignettes real-case workflow, reference database, identifier-inputs. Updated grouped function documentation README. Generated dedicated roxygen2 help pages, moved NAMESPACE roxygen2 management, re-enabled vignette building Pandoc. Added auditable SRM1950 source-name corrections two corrupted Unicode names public repository setup.
